notes: Every entry records the pinned revision, artifact URL/size/sha256, license, rights verdict, input contract and eligibility status.
verify_at_startup=true means the sidecar hashes the cached bytes under the artifact root at startup; a missing or mismatched file is reported in GET /healthz and GET /v1/providers.

required_for_readiness=true means the process readiness flag is false when that artifact fails verification. No model artifact is required for the HRV providers: the production provider is pure numpy, and the shadow provider's dependency (neurokit2) is installed from uv.lock and checked by import + version at startup.
Nothing in this manifest is downloaded at inference time. Deploy-prep stages and verifies bytes; the sidecar only reads.
Conditional models (wav2sleep, no-eeg-sleep-staging, RR_Estimation) are recorded with eligibility states and are NOT wired as live providers.

Hashes and sizes were measured from the pinned bytes (findings/conditional-models.md, findings/sleep-boundary-stager.md, findings/hrv-neurokit.md) and re-verified locally against /tmp/frwhoop-physiology/ckpt/.

Sleep candidates (2026-10-01, W-D): sleepecg_wrn_gru_mesa is now wired as sleepecg.wrn-gru-mesa.v1 with its two artifacts required_for_readiness=true (a wired model artifact gates readiness); hypnospy is wired as hypnospy.hr-boundary.v1 from an in-repo vendored copy and therefore has no artifact and required_for_readiness=false.

Sensor biomarkers (2026-10-06): paradigma/deepbeat/siamaf entries are OPTIONAL research/shadow lanes (disabled by default). required_for_readiness=false: a missing or mismatched artifact never gates process readiness; sha256/size are verified at startup only when staged under the artifact root. Hashes measured from the actual downloaded bytes (W3/W4 reports); provisioning scripts: Tools/InferenceWorker/scripts/provision_{paradigma,deepbeat,siamaf}.py.

entries.name: HypnosPy
entries.license_evidence: LICENSE file is MIT (Copyright (c) 2020 Ignacio Perez-Pozuelo, University of Cambridge & The Alan Turing Institute; Joao Palotti; Marius Posa); setup.py line 20 says license='BSD'; GitHub API reports NOASSERTION
entries.status_reason: the HR boundary algorithm was executed (2026-10-01) from an in-repo vendored copy at the pinned revision; the upstream revision does not run on the installed stack (4 pandas-3 incompatibilities plus a DST re-localisation failure), so the vendored copy carries a documented patch set (10 detector sites + 1 misc site) plus a minimal Wearable rewrite with three recorded deviations, with upstream/vendored sha256s and the full unified diff in src/frwhoop_inference/frwhoop_sleep/hypnospy_vendored/{PROVENANCE.md,UPSTREAM_DIFF.json}; no independent accuracy reference was used (unverified_accuracy). License metadata is still inconsistent (LICENSE=MIT, setup.py=BSD, GitHub=NOASSERTION), so promotion to active requires reconciliation
entries.input_contract: heart rate resampled to a fixed grid with explicit gap masking; day bounds must be supplied by FRWHOOP because HypnosPy has no IANA timezone concept
entries.artifact_note: vendored source ships in-repo, so there is no artifact to stage or hash at startup

entries.name: SleepECG wrn-gru-mesa

entries.runtime_note: optional shadow lane, disabled by default (FRWHOOP_DEEPBEAT_SHADOW_ENABLED); never user-facing; a missing artifact never gates process readiness
